title: A new Flights list
items: The Flights list shows each flight as a compact row, grouped by year.
Search the list by city, airport code, airline or flight number. Type two cities to find the flights between them.
Sort your flights by date or by distance.
A new account shows a blank boarding pass with three ways to add your first flight.

title: A new look, built for phones
items: FlyLog has a new design, with a tab bar at the bottom of the screen on phones and an add button that is always in reach.
The Stats page opens on your map, with your next or last flight as a boarding pass, your longest and shortest flights, and your charts.
All stats lists every number about your flights, including how many times your distance would go around the Earth or to the Moon.
One filter panel now filters the Stats and Flights pages, and the filters you picked show as tags.
Choose a light or dark appearance, or follow your device, from the account menu.

title: Cabin class, aircraft and automatic status checks
items: Record the cabin class of each flight. CO₂ estimates now use a different factor for each cabin.
Record the aircraft you flew on, and chart your flights by aircraft family.
When you save a flight that departs within a week, FlyLog checks its status once. A manual status check now offers any schedule changes it finds.
Some badges link to a Wikipedia article about what they celebrate.
The Route tour turns the short way across the Pacific.

title: Multi-city trips and arrival times
items: Add a multi-city trip in one go, by hand or by describing it to the AI.
Record the arrival date and time of a flight.
Earn badges for the continents you have visited.
The flights table shows cities and countries instead of airport codes.
